sanskrit: uktasyoktasya nehāntam ahaṃ samupalakṣaye yat tu vakṣyāmi tat sarvaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vasudhādhipāḥ
english: I see no end to what has already been said again and again; but hear all that I shall now say, O lords of the earth.

sanskrit: paśuvad ghātanaṃ vā me dahanaṃ vā kaṭāgninā kriyatāṃ mūrdhni vo nyastaṃ mayedaṃ sakalaṃ padam
english: Let me be slain like a beast, or burned with fire of grass — I have placed this entire position at the head of you all.

sanskrit: eṣa tiṣṭhati govindaḥ pūjito 'smābhir acyutaḥ yasya vas tvarate buddhir maraṇāya sa mādhavam
english: Here stands Govinda, the infallible one, honored by us; let him who is eager to die challenge Mādhava.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇam āhvayatām adya yuddhe śārṅgagadādharam yāvad asyaiva devasya dehaṃ viśatu pātitaḥ
english: Let him challenge Kṛṣṇa, the bearer of the Śārṅga bow and mace, in battle today — let the fallen one enter the body of this very god.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ śrutvaiva bhīṣmasya cedirāḍ uruvikramaḥ yuyutsur vāsudevena vāsudevam uvāca ha
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then, having heard Bhīṣma's words, the king of Cedi of great prowess, eager to fight, addressed Vāsudeva.

sanskrit: āhvaye tvāṃ raṇaṃ gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ janārdana yāvad adya nihanmi tvāṃ sahitaṃ sarvapāṇḍavaiḥ
english: "I challenge you — go to battle with me, O Janārdana, until today I slay you together with all the Pāṇḍavas."

sanskrit: saha tvayā hi me vadhyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇa sarvathā nṛpatīn samatikramya yair arājā tvam arcitaḥ
english: "The Pāṇḍavas too must certainly be slain by me along with you, O Kṛṣṇa, for by them — bypassing the kings — you, who are no king, have been honored."

sanskrit: ye tvāṃ dāsam arājānaṃ bālyād arcanti durmatim anarham arhavat kṛṣṇa vadhyās ta iti me matiḥ ity uktvā rājaśārdūlas tasthau garjann amarṣaṇaḥ
english: "Those who, out of foolishness, honor you — a slave and no king — as if you were worthy of honor, O Kṛṣṇa, those wicked-minded ones deserve to be slain — this is my view." Having spoken thus, that tiger among kings stood roaring with indignation.

sanskrit: evam ukte tataḥ kṛṣṇo mṛdupūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ uvāca pārthivān sarvāṃs tatsamakṣaṃ ca pāṇḍavān
english: When this was said, Kṛṣṇa then spoke these words, gentle yet firm, before all the kings and the Pāṇḍavas assembled there.

sanskrit: eṣa naḥ śatrur atyantaṃ pārthivāḥ sātvatīsutaḥ sātvatānāṃ nṛśaṃsātmā na hito 'napakāriṇām
english: "This son of Śiśupāla's mother is our ultimate enemy, O kings — cruel-natured toward the Sātvatas, and no friend to the innocent."

sanskrit: prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ yātān asmāñ jñātvā nṛśaṃsakṛt adahad dvārakām eṣa svasrīyaḥ san narādhipāḥ
english: "This cruel-doer, though my cousin's son, burned Dvārakā when he learned that we had gone to Prāgjyotiṣapura, O lords of men."

sanskrit: krīḍato bhojarājanyān eṣa raivatake girau hatvā baddhvā ca tān sarvān upāyāt svapuraṃ purā
english: "Formerly, this one slew and captured all the Bhoja princes who were sporting on Mount Raivataka and carried them to his own city."

sanskrit: aśvamedhe hayaṃ medhyam utsṛṣṭaṃ rakṣibhir vṛtam pitur me yajñavighnārtham aharat pāpaniścayaḥ
english: "This one of wicked resolve stole the consecrated horse, guarded by its protectors and released for my father's Aśvamedha sacrifice, to obstruct that ritual."

sanskrit: sauvīrān pratipattau ca babhror eṣa yaśasvinaḥ bhāryām abhyaharan mohād akāmāṃ tām ito gatām
english: "And this one abducted from here the unwilling wife of the illustrious Babhru while he was in the Sauvīra country, acting out of delusion."

sanskrit: eṣa māyāpraticchannaḥ karūṣārthe tapasvinīm jahāra bhadrāṃ vaiśālīṃ mātulasya nṛśaṃsakṛt
english: "This cruel-doer, disguised through illusion for the sake of Karūṣa, abducted the virtuous Bhadrā of Vaiśālī, the niece of my maternal uncle."

sanskrit: pitṛṣvasuḥ kṛte duḥkhaṃ sumahan marṣayāmy aham diṣṭyā tv idaṃ sarvarājñāṃ saṃnidhāv adya vartate
english: "For my father's sister's sake I have borne great sorrow; but by good fortune, the matter has now come to pass in the presence of all the kings."

sanskrit: paśyanti hi bhavanto 'dya mayy atīva vyatikramam kṛtāni tu parokṣaṃ me yāni tāni nibodhata
english: "For you see yourselves today his extreme transgression against me; but hear now of those wrongs done against me in secret."

sanskrit: imaṃ tv asya na śakṣyāmi kṣantum adya vyatikramam avalepād vadhārhasya samagre rājamaṇḍale
english: "This transgression of his — this arrogant one who deserves death — I shall not be able to forgive today before the entire assembly of kings."

sanskrit: rukmiṇyām asya mūḍhasya prārthanāsīn mumūrṣataḥ na ca tāṃ prāptavān mūḍhaḥ śūdro vedaśrutiṃ yathā
english: "This fool had designs on Rukmiṇī though he was as good as dead; but the fool did not obtain her, just as a Śūdra cannot attain the hearing of the Vedas."

sanskrit: evamādi tataḥ sarve sahitās te narādhipāḥ vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā cedirājaṃ vyagarhayan
english: Thereupon all those lords of men together, having heard Vāsudeva's words of this and like nature, censured the king of Cedi.

sanskrit: tatas tad vacanaṃ śrutvā śiśupālaḥ pratāpavān jahāsa svanavad dhāsaṃ prahasyedam uvāca ha
english: Then the mighty Śiśupāla, having heard those words, laughed a loud, resonant laugh and, still laughing, spoke thus.

sanskrit: matpūrvāṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇa saṃsatsu parikīrtayan viśeṣataḥ pārthiveṣu vrīḍāṃ na kuruṣe katham
english: "O Kṛṣṇa, how do you feel no shame in proclaiming in assemblies — and especially among kings — that Rukmiṇī was formerly intended for me?"

sanskrit: manyamāno hi kaḥ satsu puruṣaḥ parikīrtayet anyapūrvāṃ striyaṃ jātu tvad anyo madhusūdana
english: "What self-respecting man would ever proclaim in good company that a woman was previously another's — who other than you, O Madhusūdana?"

sanskrit: kṣama vā yadi te śraddhā mā vā kṛṣṇa mama kṣama kruddhād vāpi prasannād vā kiṃ me tvatto bhaviṣyati
english: "Forgive me if you wish, or do not forgive me, O Kṛṣṇa — whether in anger or in pleasure, what can I expect from you anyway?"

sanskrit: tathā bruvata evāsya bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ vyapāharac chiraḥ kruddhaś cakreṇāmitrakarṣaṇaḥ sa papāta mahābāhur vajrāhata ivācalaḥ
english: Even as he was speaking thus, the blessed Madhusūdana, the annihilator of enemies, in anger severed his head with the discus; the mighty-armed one fell like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

sanskrit: tataś cedipater dehāt tejo 'gryaṃ dadṛśur nṛpāḥ utpatantaṃ mahārāja gaganād iva bhāskaram
english: Then the kings beheld a supreme radiance rising up from the body of the lord of Cedi, O great king, like the sun rising from the sky.

sanskrit: tataḥ kamalapatrākṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lokanamaskṛtam vavande tat tadā tejo viveśa ca narādhipa
english: Then that radiance paid homage to Kṛṣṇa of lotus-petal eyes, worshipped by the world, and entered into him, O lord of men.

sanskrit: tad adbhutam amanyanta dṛṣṭvā sarve mahīkṣitaḥ yad viveśa mahābāhuṃ tat tejaḥ puruṣottamam
english: All the rulers of the earth thought it a wonder when they saw that radiance enter the mighty-armed Puruṣottama.

sanskrit: anabhre pravavarṣa dyauḥ papāta jvalitāśaniḥ kṛṣṇena nihate caidye cacāla ca vasuṃdharā
english: When the Cedi king was slain by Kṛṣṇa, the sky rained without clouds, blazing thunderbolts fell, and the earth trembled.

sanskrit: tataḥ ke cin mahīpālā nābruvaṃs tatra kiṃ cana atītavākpathe kāle prekṣamāṇā janārdanam
english: Then some of the earth's rulers said nothing at all, gazing at Janārdana when the moment was past the reach of words.

sanskrit: hastair hastāgram apare pratyapīṣann amarṣitāḥ apare daśanair oṣṭhān adaśan krodhamūrchitāḥ
english: Others, filled with indignation, pressed their hands together tight; still others, overcome with rage, bit their lips with their teeth.

sanskrit: rahas tu ke cid vārṣṇeyaṃ praśaśaṃsur narādhipāḥ ke cid eva tu saṃrabdhā madhyasthās tv apare 'bhavan
english: But some lords of men praised the descendant of Vṛṣṇi in private; some were furious, while others remained neutral.

sanskrit: prahṛṣṭāḥ keśavaṃ jagmuḥ saṃstuvanto maharṣayaḥ brāhmaṇāś ca mahātmānaḥ pārthivāś ca mahābalāḥ
english: Rejoicing, the great sages came to Keśava praising him, as did the great-souled brāhmaṇas and the mighty kings.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavas tv abravīd bhrātṝn satkāreṇa mahīpatim damaghoṣātmajaṃ vīraṃ saṃsādhayata mā ciram tathā ca kṛtavantas te bhrātur vai śāsanaṃ tadā
english: Then the Pāṇḍava addressed his brothers: "With all honor, attend to the obsequies of this hero, son of Damaghoṣa — do not delay." And they indeed fulfilled their brother's command.

sanskrit: cedīnām ādhipatye ca putram asya mahīpatim abhyaṣiñcat tadā pārthaḥ saha tair vasudhādhipaiḥ
english: Then Pārtha, together with those lords of the earth, consecrated that king's son as the ruler over the Cedis.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa kururājasya kratuḥ sarvasamṛddhimān yūnāṃ prītikaro rājan saṃbabhau vipulaujasaḥ
english: Then that sacrifice of the Kuru king, complete in all its abundance, O king, blazed forth in its full splendor, bringing joy to the young.

sanskrit: śāntavighnaḥ sukhārambhaḥ prabhūtadhanadhānyavān annavān bahubhakṣyaś ca keśavena surakṣitaḥ
english: Free from obstacles, auspiciously begun, abounding in wealth and grain, rich in food and many delicacies, it was well protected by Keśava.

sanskrit: samāpayām āsa ca taṃ rājasūyaṃ mahākratum taṃ tu yajñaṃ mahābāhur ā samāpter janārdanaḥ rarakṣa bhagavāñ śauriḥ śārṅgacakragadādharaḥ
english: And he brought to completion that great ritual, the Rājasūya; the mighty-armed Janārdana, the blessed Śauri, bearer of the Śārṅga bow, discus, and mace, guarded that sacrifice until its conclusion.

sanskrit: tatas tv avabhṛthasnātaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram samastaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatram abhigamyedam abravīt
english: Then, having bathed after the avabhṛtha rite, the King of Dharma Yudhiṣṭhira was approached by the entire assembled Kṣatriya royalty, and he spoke thus.

sanskrit: diṣṭyā vardhasi dharmajña sāmrājyaṃ prāptavān vibho ājamīḍhājamīḍhānāṃ yaśaḥ saṃvardhitaṃ tvayā karmaṇaitena rājendra dharmaś ca sumahān kṛtaḥ
english: "By fortune you thrive, O knower of dharma, O lord, having attained sovereignty; by this act, O king of kings, you have enhanced the glory of the Ājamīḍha line of Ājamīḍhas, and great dharma has been performed."

sanskrit: āpṛcchāmo naravyāghra sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitāḥ svarāṣṭrāṇi gamiṣyāmas tad anujñātum arhasi
english: "We take our leave, O tiger among men, well honored with every wish fulfilled; we shall depart to our own kingdoms — please grant us permission."

sanskrit: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ rājñāṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ yathārhaṃ pūjya nṛpatīn bhrātṝn sarvān uvāca ha
english: Having heard the words of the kings, the King of Dharma Yudhiṣṭhira duly honored the sovereigns and then addressed all his brothers.

sanskrit: rājānaḥ sarva evaite prītyāsmān samupāgatāḥ prasthitāḥ svāni rāṣṭrāṇi mām āpṛcchya paraṃtapāḥ te 'nuvrajata bhadraṃ vo viṣayāntaṃ nṛpottamān
english: "All these kings came to us out of affection; these scorchers of foes, having taken leave of me, are now departing for their own kingdoms — accompany these best of kings to the borders of their territories. May it be well with you."

sanskrit: bhrātur vacanam ājñāya pāṇḍavā dharmacāriṇaḥ yathārhaṃ nṛpamukhyāṃs tān ekaikaṃ samanuvrajan
english: Understanding their brother's command, the Pāṇḍavas, followers of dharma, duly escorted each of those foremost kings one by one.

sanskrit: virāṭam anvayāt tūrṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān dhanaṃjayo yajñasenaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahārathaḥ
english: The mighty Dhṛṣṭadyumna quickly accompanied Virāṭa; the great chariot-warrior Dhanaṃjaya accompanied the great-souled Yajñasena.

sanskrit: bhīṣmaṃ ca dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ droṇaṃ ca sasutaṃ vīraṃ sahadevo mahārathaḥ
english: The immensely powerful Bhīmasena accompanied Bhīṣma and Dhṛtarāṣṭra; the great chariot-warrior Sahadeva accompanied the heroic Droṇa together with his son.

sanskrit: nakulaḥ subalaṃ rājan sahaputraṃ samanvayāt draupadeyāḥ sasaubhadrāḥ pārvatīyān mahīpatīn
english: Nakula, O king, accompanied Subala together with his son; the sons of Draupadī along with Saubhadra accompanied the mountain kings.

sanskrit: anvagacchaṃs tathaivānyān kṣatriyān kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ evaṃ saṃpūjitās te vai jagmur viprāś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Those bulls among Kṣatriyas similarly accompanied the other Kṣatriyas; thus well-honored, they all departed, as did the brāhmaṇas in every direction.

sanskrit: gateṣu pārthivendreṣu sarveṣu bharatarṣabha yudhiṣṭhiram uvācedaṃ vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān
english: When all the royal lords had departed, O bull of the Bharata line, the mighty Vāsudeva spoke these words to Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: āpṛcche tvāṃ gamiṣyāmi dvārakāṃ kurunandana rājasūyaṃ kratuśreṣṭhaṃ diṣṭyā tvaṃ prāptavān asi
english: "I take my leave of you — I shall go to Dvārakā, O joy of the Kurus; by good fortune you have attained the Rājasūya, the foremost of sacrifices."

sanskrit: tam uvācaivam uktas tu dharmarāṇ madhusūdanam tava prasādād govinda prāptavān asmi vai kratum
english: Thus addressed, the King of Dharma spoke to Madhusūdana: "By your grace, O Govinda, I have indeed attained the sacrifice."

sanskrit: samastaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ tvatprasādād vaśānugam upādāya baliṃ mukhyaṃ mām eva samupasthitam
english: "By your grace, the entire Kṣatriya royalty became obedient and, bringing the foremost tribute, presented itself before me alone."

sanskrit: na vayaṃ tvām ṛte vīra raṃsyāmeha kathaṃ cana avaśyaṃ cāpi gantavyā tvayā dvāravatī purī
english: "Without you, O hero, we shall in no way find joy here; yet you must certainly go to the city of Dvāravatī."

sanskrit: evam uktaḥ sa dharmātmā yudhiṣṭhirasahāyavān abhigamyābravīt prītaḥ pṛthāṃ pṛthuyaśā hariḥ
english: Thus addressed, the righteous, widely-famed Hari, accompanied by Yudhiṣṭhira, approached Pṛthā and, filled with joy, spoke to her.

sanskrit: sāmrājyaṃ samanuprāptāḥ putrās te 'dya pitṛṣvasaḥ siddhārthā vasumantaś ca sā tvaṃ prītim avāpnuhi
english: "Your sons, the nephews of your husband's brothers, have today attained sovereignty — their purposes fulfilled and rich in wealth; you, therefore, rejoice."

sanskrit: anujñātas tvayā cāhaṃ dvārakāṃ gantum utsahe subhadrāṃ draupadīṃ caiva sabhājayata keśavaḥ
english: "With your permission, I am eager to depart to Dvārakā." Then Keśava duly honored Subhadrā and Draupadī.

sanskrit: niṣkramyāntaḥpurāc caiva yudhiṣṭhirasahāyavān snātaś ca kṛtajapyaś ca brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca
english: Then, having come out of the inner apartments accompanied by Yudhiṣṭhira, having bathed and performed his prayers, and having received blessings from the brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit: tato meghavaraprakhyaṃ syandanaṃ vai sukalpitam yojayitvā mahārāja dārukaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ
english: Then Dāruka, O great king, having harnessed the well-equipped chariot that resembled a rain-cloud in color, presented it ready.

sanskrit: upasthitaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tārkṣyapravaraketanam pradakṣiṇam upāvṛtya samāruhya mahāmanāḥ prayayau puṇḍarīkākṣas tato dvāravatīṃ purīm
english: Seeing the chariot prepared, bearing the emblem of the great Tārkṣya, the high-minded Puṇḍarīkākṣa circumambulated it clockwise, mounted it, and then departed for the city of Dvāravatī.

sanskrit: taṃ padbhyām anuvavrāja dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmān vāsudevaṃ mahābalam
english: The glorious King of Dharma Yudhiṣṭhira, accompanied by his brothers, followed on foot the mighty Vāsudeva.

sanskrit: tato muhūrtaṃ saṃgṛhya syandanapravaraṃ hariḥ abravīt puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Then Hari reined in his excellent chariot for a moment, and Puṇḍarīkākṣa addressed Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Kuntī.

sanskrit: apramattaḥ sthito nityaṃ prajāḥ pāhi viśāṃ pate parjanyam iva bhūtāni mahādrumam ivāṇḍajāḥ bāndhavās tvopajīvantu sahasrākṣam ivāmarāḥ
english: "Ever vigilant and steadfast, protect your subjects, O lord of the people, as the rain-cloud protects living beings, as a great tree shelters birds; may your kinsmen live by your support as the immortals live by the thousand-eyed Indra."

sanskrit: kṛtvā paraspareṇaivaṃ saṃvidaṃ kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau anyonyaṃ samanujñāpya jagmatuḥ svagṛhān prati
english: Having thus made their mutual covenant, Kṛṣṇa and the Pāṇḍava took leave of each other and departed each to his own home.

sanskrit: gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe sātvatapravare nṛpa eko duryodhano rājā śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ divyāyām ūṣatus tau nararṣabhau
english: When Kṛṣṇa, the foremost of the Sātvatas, had departed for Dvāravatī, O king, king Duryodhana alone and also Śakuni, son of Subala — those two bulls among men — lingered in that divine assembly hall.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca vasan duryodhanas tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ bharatarṣabha śanair dadarśa tāṃ sarvāṃ sabhāṃ śakuninā saha
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Dwelling in that assembly hall, O bull of the Bharata line, Duryodhana leisurely surveyed the entire hall together with Śakuni.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ divyān abhiprāyān dadarśa kurunandanaḥ na dṛṣṭapūrvā ye tena nagare nāgasāhvaye
english: In it the joy of the Kurus beheld divine wonders never seen before by him in the city called after the elephant.

sanskrit: sa kadā cit sabhāmadhye dhārtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ sphāṭikaṃ talam āsādya jalam ity abhiśaṅkayā
english: Once, in the middle of the hall, the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, that king of the earth, came upon a crystal floor, mistaking it for water.

sanskrit: svavastrotkarṣaṇaṃ rājā kṛtavān buddhimohitaḥ durmanā vimukhaś caiva paricakrāma tāṃ sabhām
english: The king, his mind confused, lifted up his garments; downcast and looking away, he wandered through that hall.

sanskrit: tataḥ sphāṭikatoyāṃ vai sphāṭikāmbujaśobhitām vāpīṃ matvā sthalam iti savāsāḥ prāpataj jale
english: Then, mistaking for dry ground a pool of crystal water adorned with crystal lotus flowers, he fell into the water fully clothed.

sanskrit: jale nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃkarā jahasur bhṛśam vāsāṃsi ca śubhāny asmai pradadū rājaśāsanāt
english: Seeing him fallen in the water, the attendants laughed heartily, and by royal order presented him with fresh, fine garments.

sanskrit: tathāgataṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ arjunaś ca yamau cobhau sarve te prāhasaṃs tadā
english: Seeing him in such a state, the immensely powerful Bhīmasena, Arjuna, and both of the twins all laughed at that moment.

sanskrit: nāmarṣayat tatas teṣām avahāsam amarṣaṇaḥ ākāraṃ rakṣamāṇas tu na sa tān samudaikṣata
english: The proud one did not endure their mockery; guarding his composure, he did not look at them.

sanskrit: punar vasanam utkṣipya pratariṣyann iva sthalam āruroha tataḥ sarve jahasus te punar janāḥ
english: Then lifting his garment again as if trying to cross dry ground, he climbed out; and once more all those people laughed.

sanskrit: dvāraṃ ca vivṛtākāraṃ lalāṭena samāhanat saṃvṛtaṃ ceti manvāno dvāradeśād upāramat
english: He also struck his forehead against a door that appeared to be open, thinking it was shut, and then drew back from the doorway.

sanskrit: evaṃ pralambhān vividhān prāpya tatra viśāṃ pate pāṇḍaveyābhyanujñātas tato duryodhano nṛpaḥ
english: Having thus suffered various humiliations there, O lord of the people, King Duryodhana was then dismissed by the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: aprahṛṣṭena manasā rājasūye mahākratau prekṣya tām adbhutām ṛddhiṃ jagāma gajasāhvayam
english: With a joyless heart, having witnessed that wondrous prosperity at the great Rājasūya sacrifice, he departed for the city named after the elephant.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavaśrīprataptasya dhyānaglānasya gacchataḥ duryodhanasya nṛpateḥ pāpā matir ajāyata
english: As king Duryodhana went, scorched by the Pāṇḍavas' prosperity and sickened with brooding, a wicked thought arose in his mind.

sanskrit: pārthān sumanaso dṛṣṭvā pārthivāṃś ca vaśānugān kṛtsnaṃ cāpi hitaṃ lokam ākumāraṃ kurūdvaha
english: Having seen the Pārthas cheerful and contented, the kings obedient to them, and the entire world well-disposed toward them down to the children, O bull of the Kuru line,

sanskrit: mahimānaṃ paraṃ cāpi pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām duryodhano dhārtarāṣṭro vivarṇaḥ samapadyata
english: and having seen too the supreme greatness of the great-souled Pāṇḍavas, Duryodhana, son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, became pale.

sanskrit: sa tu gacchann anekāgraḥ sabhām evānucintayan śriyaṃ ca tām anupamāṃ dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ
english: As he traveled on, his mind distracted, brooding only on that assembly hall and the incomparable glory of the wise King of Dharma,
